# Verify m1 observable behavior
from funcy import memoize, SkipMemoization

f = memoize(lambda x: x * 2)
result = f(3)
print("m1 - f(3) =", result)
print("m1 - f.memory =", f.memory)
assert f.memory == {(3,): 6}, f"Expected {{(3,): 6}}, got {f.memory}"
print("m1 - f.skip is SkipMemoization:", f.skip is SkipMemoization)
assert f.skip is SkipMemoization

f.invalidate(3)
print("m1 - after invalidate(3), f.memory =", f.memory)
assert f.memory == {}

f(3)  # repopulate
print("m1 - after f(3) again, f.memory =", f.memory)
f.invalidate_all()
print("m1 - after invalidate_all(), f.memory =", f.memory)
assert f.memory == {}
print("m1: PASSED")
